about: BH-5005: classifies state/<path> for bin/state-paths-guard.sh. rows = a DB row is the record and a new script must not write the file; cache = a local copy of rows, rebuildable; box-local = belongs to this box only. A path not listed here is unclassified and passes.

paths.note:
state/pool/

/: *.spawns, *.terminal, *.held and _spawn-hold have row twins (pool_spawns, pool_terminals, pool_holds; BH-5001). *.terminal-noted, *.terminal-alerted, *.after-since, *.after-released, *.after-loop and *.defer-to-human (marker name cap-wait) now have pool_markers row twins behind pool_state_rows (BH-7431); the files stay and are written first. *.hold-noted and *.pr-noted are files only, carried by fly-pool.rw. hold-cache/.json (BH-6549) is a machine-local cache under the same dir, carried by fly-pool.rw state/pool/$p/**. Writers: bin/fly-pool.sh, bin/lib/br-pool-terminals.sh (.terminal-noted)

paths.authority: the deploy snapshot lane's per-box push fail streak (BH-8545)
paths.note: state/vercel-snapshot-push-fail/<box>: one overwritten file per target box holding the count of failed pushes in a row, bin/vercel-deploy-snapshot.sh. Hub-only lane; the count is a fact about this hub's ssh path to the box. A success deletes the file, so it holds at most one file per vercel.conf box. Losing it on a hub move delays one ALERTS line by one streak. No growth, no retention job. Machine-local, never carried

paths.note:
state/review-prs-pat-alert/

paths.authority: the hub main-red breaker's once-per-episode log, warn and requeue-done notes (BH-8706)
paths.note: state/main-red-breaker/ (ST in bin/main-red-breaker.sh): <slug>.noprov and <slug>.nohook (one log line per episode), <key>.warned (one warn per failed ticket create), <slug@since>.rq-<n> (one @mergifyio requeue per PR per episode). The records that dedup are DB rows: main_red_hotfix and main_red_breaker in the job ledger. Losing a file costs at most one extra log line, warn or requeue. Hub lane only, never carried

paths.authority: bin/pm-groom.sh keep_answer: a failed brief write's paid answer, for a person on this box (BH-7261)
paths.note:
state/pm-groom/

.failed-create.json: one file per project, overwritten by the next failed write, so it never grows. The pm_briefs claim row stays the record (claimed, billed); --force by a person re-runs the week. Machine-local, never carried

state/unblock-judge/<fp>.json {outcome, attempts, answer, cost_usd, ts}: bin/lib/unblock/judge.sh, the judge's memo of paid answers and attempt counts on the box that runs the unblock tick (the hub). The spend dedup is the claim row: bin/unblock.sh claims a decision (UNIQUE on decision_key, which names the PR head and the rule) before the judge runs, and a seen key is a 409 with 0 judge calls (tests/unblock-review-rules.bh-7724-test.sh C16). Losing the files costs at most one re-ask on a direct unblock_judge call. Pruned after UNBLOCK_JUDGE_LEDGER_DAYS (default 30). Machine-local, never carried

paths.authority: the lead_reviews result row and the lead_part ledger rows (BH-8533)
paths.note: state/lead-reviews/: lr-<pr>-<sha12>.md, the full lead report of a review run on this box (the result row keeps a 4000-unit cut). parts/<owner_repo>-<pr>-<sha12>-p<k>of<N>.md (BH-8533): the full answer of one part review; the lead_part ledger row is the record and keeps a cut body, so a resume on another box with a cut row does not reuse it (fail closed, part-lost). Writers: bin/lead-review.sh, bin/lib/lead-part-review.sh
